intro: Outside Westbrook Garrison, Deputy Rainer holds Elwynn's western border. The Stormwind Army officer faces gnolls and bandits from Westfall, coordinating local defenses while reinforcements fail to arrive.

p: At Westbrook Garrison, Elwynn Forest's westernmost post, the road crosses into Westfall. Political paralysis in Stormwind City leaves much of the army abroad or caught in bureaucracy, and border posts like this one lack troops. Deputy Rainer organizes the defense from outside the tower with the few forces at hand. Riverpaw gnolls and wandering thieves threaten the local roads, so he depends on passing travelers and mercenary adventurers to keep the forest trails secure.

Deputy Rainer watches for the Riverpaw pack and warns travelers about Hogger, the infamous gnoll chieftain. He also carries word of the troubled lands beyond the river. The chaos at Elwynn's border begins in Westfall's lawless farmlands, so he sends capable volunteers across the border toward Gryan Stoutmantle and the struggling People's Militia.
